conclusion: If (nu.rnDeriv mu).toReal = exp(-M-Q) mu-a.e., then mu is absolutely continuous with respect to nu. For sigma-finite measures, llr mu nu = M+Q mu-a.e. Integrable M and Q imply integrable llr mu nu. If the mu-integral of M is zero, the mu-integral of llr mu nu equals the mu-integral of Q.
scope: Genuine measure-theoretic Radon-Nikodym inversion and log-likelihood identity. No Girsanov construction, data processing, stochastic mean-zero proof, or identification with the extended-real klDiv primitive is asserted. No finiteness assumptions for the absolute-continuity helper; SigmaFinite mu and nu for the remaining theorems.
library_scope_choice: Used the actual Mathlib logLikelihoodRatio formulation allowed by the task. At initial inspection KullbackLeibler.Basic required 43 uncached dependencies; LogLikelihoodRatio required only the three modules recorded above.
